observations: long cylindrical silver-grey body, broad flat head and small mouth
faint longitudinal flank stripes and dark pectoral-base patch
four-spine first dorsal separated from the soft second dorsal
forked caudal and relatively high pectoral fin bases

anatomical_reference.scope: Grey mullet is visually interpreted as the Mugil cephalus complex in the inspected reference; exact cryptic-species identification is not claimed.
